newsitem.title: USA: Ivy to close international fund to new investors.
newsitem.headline: Ivy to close international fund to new investors.

text.p: Ivy Mackenzie Distributors Inc said it was closing its Ivy International Fund to new investors, effective April 18.
Ivy said that in order for the fund to be able to achieve increasing returns, it had to control the amount of money flowing into the fund. It currently has about $2 billion in assets.
Ivy said it would launch a new fund, Ivy International Fund II, about May 13. Hakan Castegren, the manager of the closing fund, will not manage the new fund, Ivy said.
The new fund will be managed by Ivy Management Inc, which is not affiliated with Categran's firm.
An Ivy Mackenzie spokeswoman said Castegran would not work on the new fund because of the demands of managing other funds and private accounts.
Ivy Mackenzie is a unit of Mackenzie Investment Management Inc.
